title: EffectReceipt
description: POST-EFFECT RECEIPT (ARCHITECTURE.md §24a): 'requested vs authorized vs observed effect, actual diff, host-observed evidence, replay protection.' A model's statement that it edited/tested/deployed something is never an effect receipt (§24a, I-07); only host-observed events are. requested/authorized/observed effect identity are kept as three separate objects by design, per the WP2 task instruction and archive §7.9. `authentication` and `replayDefense` were added mid-freeze per the S00 predecessor semantic baseline (docs/plans/legion/s00-baseline/legacy-semantic-inventory.json): predecessor's `signature_or_mac` on `orthic.tool-receipt.v1` is a self-hash, not authentication, and no nonce/sequence/freshness field exists anywhere in legacy predecessor records — this schema does not repeat that gap.

contractId.description: Amendment A-ER-1 (2026-08-09): null = ambient observation — a host-observed effect in a session bound to a run but not to a contract. Mirrors evidence-capability-receipt-v1's pre-existing nullable pattern. Rationale: evidence != authorization; recording an uncontracted mutation is never a false clean, refusing to record it is a coverage hole. A post-effect event with no runId at all is STILL refused.

taskId.description: Amendment A-ER-1 (2026-08-09): null = ambient observation (see contractId).

match.description: True only when requested == authorized == observed on effectClass/target/operation. False triggers Arcane reconciliation, not silent acceptance (G2, §24a).

hostEventRef.description: Reference to the host-observed event that grounds 'observed' (I-07: model self-report is never sufficient).

issuerIdentity.description: Who/what asserted this effect (process/capability/user identity). Real identity, not a self-hash — S00 finding: predecessor's signature_or_mac authenticates nothing.

perMessage.description: S00 finding: predecessor's one real trust primitive (lib/host.js process-identity/code-signing check) authenticates a connection once at MCP startup, not each message. false means this receipt's authentication is inherited from connection-level trust only; true means Arcane verified this specific effect.

authentication.description: Distinct from effectIdentity.capabilityId: capabilityId names which grant authorized the effect; authentication states how strongly we know who is asserting requested/observed. Added at coordinator direction from the S00 predecessor baseline.

replayDefense.description: S00 finding: no nonce/sequence/freshness field exists anywhere in legacy predecessor records; consumeRetry fingerprinting solves duplicate-retry bounding, not adversarial replay. This is greenfield scaffolding for S03, not a migrated mechanism — all fields nullable until S03 defines the real semantics.

replayOf.description: Non-null marks this receipt as a detected replay of a prior receipt (replay protection, §24a).

capabilityId.description: Present on 'authorized'; the Arcane-issued capability grounding this identity.
